stem:
Komal must draw a line through point $P$ that is parallel to a given line $AB$.

Which claim correctly describes the construction?

options.text: Keep the same angle relationship to $AB$ (for example with a set square) so the new line through $P$ does not meet $AB$.
Report the words given point as the parallel line.
Point $P$ produces line $AB$, so move $AB$ until it passes through $P$ instead of drawing a new line through $P$.
Read arrow marks that mean parallel as the construction steps, without drawing a new line through $P$.

teacher.key_rationale: A parallel through P keeps equal corresponding angles with AB so the lines never meet. Naming the point label, moving AB onto P, or reading notation marks as the construction miss that hinge.
